- **TransitOverlay-portable.exe**: the desktop app for Windows. Run it, no install needed. Windows SmartScreen may warn because it isn't signed: More info → Run anyway.
- **TransitOverlay-linux-x86_64.AppImage**: the desktop app for Linux. Make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it.
- **transit_overlay-mod.zip**: the in-game button, for installing by hand. Most players should subscribe on [mod.io](https://mod.io/g/transportfever3/m/transit-overlay) instead.

Click the Transit Overlay button at the top left of the game screen; the app updates within a couple of seconds.
